title: Technology: 3T MRI in St. Pete

slides.title: What 3T means.
steps: 3 Tesla is twice the field strength of a standard 1.5T MRI.
Helps with small structures like the brain, prostate, cartilage and nerves.
Sharp images can take less time in the scanner.
slides.footnote: 3T MRI at 2201 Central Ave, St. Petersburg. Your doctor can tell you if 3T suits your scan.

slides.title: What it feels like.
items: Loud tapping and knocking is normal. We give you earplugs or headphones.
No radiation, just magnets and radio waves.
The opening is a bit narrower. Want more room? Ask about our open MRI in Seminole.
slides.footnote: Source: U.S. FDA, MRI benefits and risks.

slides.title: Before your 3T MRI
items: Tell us about any implant, pacemaker, stent or metal in your body. Some cleared for 1.5T aren't cleared for 3T.
Leave jewelry, watches and hair clips at home.
Wear comfy clothes with no metal zippers or underwire.
Arrive 15 minutes early for forms and safety screening.
slides.footnote: Source: U.S. FDA, MRI benefits and risks.

captions.gbp:
Our strongest MRI costs the same as our others. Advanced Medical Imaging's 3T MRI at 2201 Central Ave in St. Petersburg has twice the field strength of a standard 1.5T MRI, which helps show fine detail in small structures like the brain, prostate, cartilage and nerves. MRI uses magnets and radio waves, not radiation. Loud tapping is normal, and we provide earplugs or headphones. Most scans take 30 to 75 minutes. Before your scan, tell us about any implant, pacemaker, stent or metal in your body, since some devices cleared for 1.5T are not cleared for 3T. Self-pay 3T MRI is $295 without contrast and $395 with and without contrast, the same price as all our MRIs, with the radiologist's reading included and no referral needed for self-pay. Insurance is accepted too, with a doctor's order.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

carousel: A man in a white coat points at spine MRI images on a monitor, with an MRI scanner visible through the window behind him. Our strongest MRI. Same $295 price.

What 3T means: twice the magnet, as 3 Tesla is twice the field strength of a standard 1.5T MRI; finer detail for small structures like the brain, prostate, cartilage and nerves; often quicker, as sharp images can take less time in the scanner.

What it feels like: loud tapping and knocking is normal and earplugs or headphones are provided; no radiation, just magnets and radio waves; most scans take 30 to 75 minutes; the opening is a bit narrower, and an open MRI is available in Seminole.

Before your 3T MRI: tell us about any implant, pacemaker, stent or metal in your body, since some cleared for 1.5T are not cleared for 3T; leave jewelry, watches and hair clips at home; wear comfy clothes with no metal zippers or underwire; arrive 15 minutes early.
Simple to book in St. Pete: $295 self-pay 3T MRI without contrast, $395 with and without contrast, no referral needed for self-pay, same-week appointments often available.
